steps.title: Present the code
steps.alt: Illustrated phone screen showing a payment QR code, a countdown until the code refreshes, and a masked source account.
steps.caption: The customer shows a payment code at the counter. The screen keeps the code readable and makes its expiry visible.

pins.text: Source account confirmed before the cashier scans.
Expiry countdown, so a stale code is never a surprise.

steps.title: Awaiting confirmation
steps.alt: Illustrated phone screen with a progress indicator reading 'Waiting for the merchant' and a note that the receipt will also arrive as a notification.
steps.caption: After scanning, the result arrives asynchronously. The screen says what is happening and that a notification will follow if the app is closed.

pins.text: An explicit waiting state instead of a silent spinner.
Tells the customer they can leave — the receipt also arrives as a notification.

steps.title: Receipt feedback
steps.alt: Illustrated phone screen showing a successful payment receipt with a sample merchant, amount and reference, above a notification banner.
steps.caption: The outcome is confirmed with a receipt summary, whether the customer stayed on screen or returned from a notification.

pins.text: The notification path lands on the same receipt.
A reference to quote if anything goes wrong.

steps.title: Card information
steps.alt: Illustrated phone screen showing a sample card with masked number, status, and actions for block, activate and change PIN.
steps.caption: Card details and the actions that apply to the card's current status appear together.

pins.text: Actions match the card's current status.
Details are loaded separately from the card itself.

steps.title: Partial-data failure
steps.alt: Illustrated phone screen where the card summary is shown but one section reads 'Limit details unavailable' with a Retry button.
steps.caption: When one part fails to load, the rest of the screen stays useful and the failed section offers its own retry.

pins.text: The failure stays inside its own section.
Block, activate and change PIN remain usable.

steps.title: Recovered information
steps.alt: Illustrated phone screen with every section loaded, including the previously failed limit details.
steps.caption: After a retry, the missing section is filled in and the rest of the screen stays where it was.

pins.text: The missing section is filled in — nothing else resets.
A quiet confirmation instead of a full-screen refresh.

steps.title: Ready to tap
steps.alt: Illustrated screen asking the customer to hold the phone near the reader, with the paying account and an NFC indicator.
steps.caption: Before reaching the reader, the customer sees which account will pay and that the phone is ready to tap.

pins.text: The paying account is clear before the tap.
Shows the phone is ready to tap.

steps.title: Keep holding
steps.alt: Illustrated screen with a progress ring reading "Keep holding" and a note to tap again if the phone moved away too soon.
steps.caption: While the phone is near the reader, the screen says to hold still and what to do if the tap did not complete.

pins.text: Asks the customer to keep holding while the phone talks to the reader.
Says what to do if the tap did not complete.

steps.title: Receipt
steps.alt: Illustrated receipt for a sample QRIS Tap payment.
steps.caption: Looking back at the screen, the customer gets a clear result and a receipt, as with any QR payment.

pins.text: A clear result when the customer looks back at the screen.
The receipt names the payment method.

steps.title: Scan the code
steps.alt: Illustrated camera screen with a scanning frame around a sample QRIS code.
steps.caption: The transfer starts from the camera, with a clear target and a message about what to scan.

pins.text: A clear target for the camera.
Says what kind of code to point at.

steps.title: Confirm the recipient
steps.alt: Illustrated confirmation screen showing a masked recipient name and bank, a reminder to check the name, and an amount.
steps.caption: The recipient is shown before any money moves, next to the amount and the paying account.

pins.text: The recipient is shown before any money moves.
The amount the customer is about to send.

steps.title: Transfer receipt
steps.alt: Illustrated receipt for a sample QRIS Transfer with a reference.
steps.caption: The completed transfer ends with a receipt and a reference to share or quote later.

pins.text: A clear result for the completed transfer.
A reference to share or quote later.

steps.title: Merchant abroad
steps.alt: Illustrated screen showing a sample merchant abroad, an amount in Singapore dollars and its approximate rupiah value.
steps.caption: After scanning, the customer sees the merchant’s amount in its own currency and in rupiah.

pins.text: The merchant's amount, in the merchant's currency.
Its rupiah equivalent, right next to it.

steps.title: Review the conversion
steps.alt: Illustrated review screen listing the merchant amount, a sample exchange rate and the rupiah amount to pay.
steps.caption: The review makes clear which amount will be charged to the rupiah account.

pins.text: A sample rate, shown before paying.
The rupiah amount that will be charged.

steps.title: Receipt in both currencies
steps.alt: Illustrated receipt showing the rupiah amount paid and the merchant amount in Singapore dollars.
steps.caption: The receipt keeps both amounts so the payment is easy to reconcile later.

pins.text: The rupiah amount paid.
The merchant amount stays on the receipt.

steps.title: Prepare the transaction
steps.alt: Illustrated screen with a withdraw or deposit switch, the paying account and preset amounts.
steps.caption: The customer chooses withdrawal or deposit, the account and the amount before a code is created.

pins.text: Withdraw or deposit is chosen first.
The amount is set before a code exists.

steps.title: Your code
steps.alt: Illustrated screen showing a six-digit sample code to enter at the ATM and a countdown until it expires.
steps.caption: The code is large and easy to type at the ATM, with its remaining time clearly visible.

pins.text: Large digits, easy to type at the ATM.
Time left is always visible.

steps.title: Active codes
steps.alt: Illustrated list of two active sample codes, each with its purpose, amount and time left.
steps.caption: Active codes are listed in one place, each with what it is for and how long it lasts.

pins.text: Time left on every active code.
All active codes in one place.
